claims.claim: A non-production on-premise 2211 runtime may be used during migration subject to licensing.

items.resolution: Teach public cloud as the supported production boundary. Treat temporary non-production migration use as a community-described, license-dependent procedure requiring SAP confirmation.

claims.claim: OCC documentation describes OAuth 2.0 as the default framework.
The legacy oauth2 extension is removed in the JDK 21 line and replaced by authorizationserver/resourceserver/oauth2commons.

items.resolution: State OAuth 2.0 protocol behavior separately from the implementing extensions. Version every configuration example and prefer the JDK 21 migration guide for current implementation details.

claims.claim: Accelerator UI and older OCC template/AddOn paths are deprecated with planned removal.
Includes deprecated Accelerator artifacts for showcase only and warns against new use.

items.resolution: Keep legacy content for maintenance and modernization labs; prohibit it as the default greenfield architecture.

claims.claim: Open-source Spartacus and supported Composable Storefront have different support/versioning boundaries; numbering aligns from 2211.19.

items.resolution: Require compatibility-matrix evidence for each lab and distinguish open-source branch behavior from supported customer libraries.

claims.claim: Recommends testing every items.xml update against production-like data and warns about schema debt.
Documents supported update scenarios and data-preserving behavior.

items.resolution: Use the independent source as engineering rationale only; derive supported schema behavior from SAP Help and validate against the target database/runtime.
